channel.title: LMAX incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from LMAX's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Prematurely closed UAT Maintenance [resolved]
item.description:
The extended UAT maintenance has been completed successfuly. We have released a new version of the software and conducted other urgent maintenance.
Please accept our sincere apologies for the delay.

item.title: P1 - INC0024145 - PERPS issue in Prod and Demo [resolved]
item.description: Resolved: Release was pushed to both PERPS Demo and Production and we are back up and running now.

item.title: LMAX Global: Crypto Deposits in Broker [resolved]
Delays in external emails sent from lmax.com and lmaxdigital.com [resolved]
PD #1525: Digital broker's custodian 2 integration has stopped detecting deposits after kit44 patch release. [resolved]
item.description: We are pleased to announce the incident has now been resolved. We investigated the issue, identified a fix, raised a change request for the proposed resolution and actioned the change. This has been tested and confirmed resolved.

item.title: Java API rejections in London Professional [resolved]
DFX Trading Portal is unavailable [resolved]
item.description: The incident has been resolved as of 14:42 UTC.

item.title: LMAX Global Trading platform down [resolved]
item.description: Please note this incident is now resolved. For further queries, please do hesitate to contact our LMAX Client Services team via info@lmax.com or via +44 20 3192 2555.

item.title: Perpetual Futures Order Entry UAT Outage [resolved]
Pyth price not updating in Perpetual Futures [resolved]
item.description:
Trading was briefly suspended on the Production Perpetual Futures Exchange due to an issue connecting to a third-party pricing source.
All functionality has now resumed; markets were opened at 13:55 BST.
